title: Fih.
body:
**This mod adds a silly little fish named Fih!**
 
 You can find him in the wild semi-commonly (maybe a little more depending on your definition) and he is supposed to look a little "goofy", so he is NOT BROKEN OR GLITCHED. When killed... lets just say pick up what he drops and run. 
 
 Oh yeah! he drops a fih shirt which is a bit op but cool (maybe dont look on the back (trust))
 
 Also, if you craft 4 fih shirts together you get the fih blast! The fih blast allows you to shoot a blast! (who could of guessed)
 
  
  
 
 
 I have a YT channel! (I'm trying to start to make vids again! And a showcase of this mod is coming soon!): https://www.youtube.com/@Maximusslide

 **THIS MOD IS PRETTY OP SO DONT USE THIS IN A SLOW PROGRESSION WORLD OR A WORLD YOU WANT TO BE BALANCED**
